resources.string: PurrRescue is a community-driven initiative focused on helping stray cats through reporting, rescue tracking, and community support. \nOur goal is to make it easier for people to take action when they encounter a cat in need and to create a safer future for stray cats everywhere.
Protect stray cats \nEncourage community participation \nCreate a transparent rescue tracking system

Many stray cats go unnoticed because people don\'t know whom to contact or how to help. \nPurrRescue provides a simple way to report, track, and update rescue cases, allowing communities to work together and improve the lives of cats in need.
Help, report a cat to see it here!
